purpose: PRE-REGISTERED selection rule for a replacement comparator meta (Mahmood 6 Oct: 'solve it through comparator swaps'). Committed BEFORE any candidate search; candidates are judged per criterion from their own text, and the pick follows from R0, the criteria and the tie-breaks alone. How our pool compares with any candidate is NOT an input.

protocol_reference.question: In adults with acute symptomatic venous thromboembolism (VTE), do direct oral anticoagulants change recurrent VTE versus warfarin / vitamin-K antagonist therapy?
protocol_reference.eligibility: RCT; adults with acute symptomatic VTE (DVT and/or PE) by title/registry conditions; DOAC (dabigatran, rivaroxaban, apixaban, or edoxaban) vs warfarin / VKA / conventional anticoagulant therapy; P/I/C/design only. Exclude cancer-only, thrombophilia-only, pediatric, extended/secondary-prevention, and placebo/aspirin comparator trials.
protocol_reference.primary_outcome: Symptomatic recurrent VTE (DVT / nonfatal PE / fatal PE or VTE-related death)
protocol_reference.timepoint: trial end / longest randomized acute-treatment follow-up

R0_current_comparator.test: the current comparator is assessed against C1-C6 by the same procedure as every candidate. It is RETIRED only if it fails at least one criterion (reason = that criterion, span = its evidence); if it passes all six it is KEPT and the topic is NO_SWAP (the block is acquisition, not the comparator).

criteria.pass_if: the meta's full text is held under CC BY or CC0 (Europe PMC licence field, else the Unpaywall location licence); any other licence, or free-to-read without a licence, fails (lane licence rule)
the analysis pools randomised controlled trials only (its own eligibility / methods statement)

the pooled analysis is in the protocol's population: In adults with acute symptomatic venous thromboembolism (VTE), do direct oral anticoagulants change recurrent VTE versus warfarin / vitamin-K antagonist therapy? (eligibility: RCT; adults with acute symptomatic VTE (DVT and/or PE) by title/registry conditions; DOAC (dabigatran, rivaroxaban, apixaban, or edoxaban) vs warfarin / VKA / conventional anticoagulant therapy; P/I/C/design only. Exclude cancer-only, thrombophilia-only, pediatric, extended/secondary-prevention, and placebo/aspirin comparator trials.)

the pooled comparison is dabigatran / rivaroxaban / apixaban / edoxaban / direct oral anticoagulant / direct oral anticoagulants versus warfarin / vitamin K antagonist / vitamin k antagonist / VKA / standard therapy / standard treatment

it pools Symptomatic recurrent VTE (DVT / nonfatal PE / fatal PE or VTE-related death) (protocol timepoint: trial end / longest randomized acute-treatment follow-up) on the estimand family ratio (HR, RR or OR)
it prints per-trial rows for that outcome (a table, or a forest plot with counts or effects, in the article or its own open supplement) AND a pooled result for it

tie_breaks.score: number of trials in the pooled analysis of the protocol outcome

if_none_pass: NO_ACHIEVABLE_COMPARATOR: record the closest candidate and its single failing criterion; the topic keeps its current comparator; no criterion is relaxed after the search
selector: scripts/g1_comparator_select.py (deterministic; reads this rule and the typed candidates file)
process: scripts/g1_swap.py (rules -> search -> screen -> select); enumeration and acquisition follow the pick
